text:
maya: Quick design check — streaming messages feel jumpy when stop/regenerate is hit. token counter sometimes flashes to 0 when stream restarts.
sam: repro for me too. happens when we switch to compact rail. maybe the meter is re-mounting.
jordan: I think the issue is the token-bar component unmounting on stream state change. We debounce start/stop but unmount is immediate.
maya: Screenshot: https://imgur.com/abcd (mock) — notice counter resets before final token batch arrives.
ken: Accessibility nit: voiceover reads "0 tokens" when stream pauses. We should announce "stream paused, partial response" instead.
sarah: UX ask: when user hits stop then regenerate, can we preserve the original prompt in the prompt library quick-recall? currently it clears selection.
sam: Proposed change: keep last-send prompt pinned as "recent" in the prompt drawer and preselect on regen. Also add small undo toast: "Restore previous response".
jordan: Implementation idea: don't unmount token meter; toggle a class instead. CSS tweak:
```
.token-meter.hidden{opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.token-meter.active{transition:opacity .12s}
```
That should stop VoiceOver jumping.
dev-bot: deploy-preview created: playground-stream-fix-1767 — https://staging.redwood/dev/1767 — tests: token-meter, accessibility.
maya: visual nit: token badge overlaps rerun button at 320px width. Can we move token pill to left of actions when compact?
ken: +1. Also contrast on small pill is 3.1:1 — below AA. Need darker bg.
sarah: copy tweak: change "Stop" to "Pause" when stream is pending and add tooltip "Pause output, keep partial result".
sam: small concern: persisting prompt in drawer might hide mutable state for users editing prompt pre-regen. Let's make it restore-only and not auto-apply.
maya: sounds good. Can someone put together final spec with visuals? I'll schedule a 15m sync if needed.
sarah: I'll mock visuals in Figma and post link by EOD.
jordan: assign to @sam for front-end change and @ken for a11y. I'll do the token-meter small refactor.
sam: got it. I'll PR today. tag @maya on review.
maya: thanks all :thumbsup:
